The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fried Egg and Rice are [[Meal]]s that can be made by [[Cooking]] predominantly [[Bird Egg]]s and [[Hylian Rice]] together. If consumed, they restore at least six of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The soft egg yolks of this dish are known to pair well with the fresh rice. Adding additional Ingredients can result in several different variations of Fried Eggs and Rice: * '''Hearty Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Fried Egg and Rice}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating these will completely heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum number of Hearts. * '''Energizing Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Fried Egg and Rice}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding stamina-related Ingredients. If eaten, they will refill of a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Fried Egg and Rice}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Consuming these dishes will completely refill and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Fried Egg and Rice}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding speed-boosting Ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's movement speed for a short time. * '''Spicy Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Fried Egg and Rice}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding warm Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when these are eaten. * '''Electro Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Fried Egg and Rice}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electricity-related Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Fried Egg and Rice}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. Eating one of these dishes will increase Link's attack power for a short period of time. * '''Tough Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Fried Egg and Rice}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding defensive Ingredients. If they are eaten, they will temporarily increase Link's defense. * '''Sneaky Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Fried Egg and Rice}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding stealthy Ingredients. When these dishes are consumed, they wil provide a temporary boost to Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Fried Egg and Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Fried Egg and Rice}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The soft egg yolk pairs well with the fresh rice in this simple dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Omelet * Seafood Fried Rice }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
